caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher, rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite on a plain, light background. The pitcher features a prominent, curved handle on the left side, and a wide, flared spout on the right. Its body is decorated with detailed, vertically elongated grooves that extend from just below the rim to about halfway down the vessel. The lower half of the pitcher is adorned with symmetrical, swirling and leaf-like patterns, as well as a scalloped design encircling the bottom. The outline and shading suggest a three-dimensional form, emphasizing the contours and decorative elements. The artist's signature is located in the bottom left corner of the paper. The overall composition is centered with the object occupying most of the visual space.
title: Pitcher
